tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Mango Development and Marketing Corporation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: KSMDMCL Managing Director Head Office Bengaluru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per terms and conditions of tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Registered Company/Agency incorporated under the Indian Companies/Society Act and have been in existence for a period of at least three years to date.
The Agency should have a minimum of Three years experience in the relevant field

Agencies Black listed by Government of Karnataka/Government of India / Semi Government undertaking/Government Institutions like Universities etc., in the last three years are liable to rejection. The Karnataka State Mango Development and Marketing Corporation Ltd. Bengaluru holds the right to terminate the agreement if any of the agencies are found black listed subsequently or later
Agencies failing to meet these criteria or not submitting requisite supporting proof are liable to be rejected during evaluation stage
Valid GST Registration certificate & PAN number
Certificate of registration under Professional Tax (PT) issued from State Commercial Tax Department
Registration Certificate with Employee State Insurance (ESI) and PF authorities

The Agency shall have a minimum average turn over of Rs.120.00 lakhs for the last two assessment years (A.Y 2024-25 and 2025-26) or a minimum of Rs.59.23 lakhs turn over for each assessment year for the at least two assessment years (A.Y 2024-25 and 2025-26)
